title: DUAL-Bench: Measuring Over-Refusal and Robustness in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating 'over-refusal' by measuring the rate at which models unnecessarily refuse benign instructions that are accompanied by sensitive or harmful visual contexts, using automated LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines to compute Refusal Rates (RR) and Safe Completion Rates (SCR).

Applying cross-lingual text perturbations (translating instructions into Urdu, Arabic, and Chinese) to measure disparities and degradation in the models' safety alignment, robustness, and refusal behaviors compared to English prompts.

Comparing model over-refusal and direct answer rates across 12 distinct hazard categories (e.g., Suicide & Self-Harm vs. Intellectual Property) to identify disproportionate alignment sensitivity, over-caution, or under-sensitivity in specific topical domains.
